company.shortDescription: GC Therapeutics uses synthetic biology to program patient-derived stem cells into various cell types in an efficient and scalable manner.
company.description: GC Therapeutics uses synthetic biology to program patient-derived stem cells into various cell types in an efficient and scalable manner. They have verified cells for several applications by dictating cell fates in a single step. They've also created SuperCells™ by customizing cells for certain conditions. Professor George Church's lab at Harvard Medical School is where GC Therapeutics' fundamental technology was developed, invented, and refined. They are a group of dedicated biologists and tissue engineers whose mission is to bring this ground-breaking method to patients.

aiResearchSummary.text: GC Therapeutics is engaged in developing methods and compositions for stem cell differentiation, as described in Methods and compositions for stem cell differentiation. The abstract details transcription factors and techniques for directing pluripotent stem cells to become hepatocytes or hepatic cells, involving nucleic acids encoding specific factors. Their research focuses on programming stem cells into targeted cell types, particularly hepatic cells, using synthetic biology approaches.
